Text:
[II] The Christ is the joy for all who hope in Him, we pray to You:
[IR] Look upon us with favor, Lord, and answer us.
[I1] Faithful witness and firstborn of those who have died, Your blood has washed us of our sins,
[I2] flood our minds with your wondrous deeds.
[I1] You have called some to herald and proclaim your Gospel,
[I2] let them be found faithful and diligent to embody and speak the mysteries of Your Kingdom for Your people.
[I1] King of Peace, send Your Spirit onto the leaders of our world,
[I2] turning their eyes towards the needs of the poor, marginalized, and oppressed.
[I1] Counselor and Protector of those suffering discrimination because of their race, color, class, ability, gender, sex, language, or religion,
[I2] may Your will be done that they receive recognition of their rights and dignity.
[I1] May all who have died in Your love share in Your blessings
[I2] together with Mary, our mother, and all the holy ones you treasure.
Changes: 2025-02-08 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions
